title: 03 — AMAT / CPI — 正式整理中
markdown:
### 03 — AMAT / CPI — 正式整理中 #### AMAT — Average Memory Access Time (cycles/access) **Hit** → Found in current Cache；**Miss** → Fetch from next level → Fill Cache $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{L1/L2 can both Hit or Miss; Cold Miss is only one type of Miss; DRAM = physical Main Memory (RAM).}}$ **Local vs Global Miss Rate** $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{Example: 100 Accesses; L1 Miss: 10; L2 Miss: 2}}$
```svg ```
**Local Miss Rate — L2** $m_{L2}^{\mathrm{local}}=\frac{\mathrm{Miss}_{L2}}{\mathrm{Access}_{L2}}=\frac{2}{10}=20\%$ **Global Miss Rate — L2** $m_{L2}^{\mathrm{global}}=\frac{\mathrm{Miss}_{L2}}{\mathrm{Access}_{\mathrm{total}}}=\frac{2}{100}=2\%$
**Core Formula** $$ \boxed{AMAT=T_{\mathrm{hit}}+m\times P_{\mathrm{miss}}} $$ $ \color{gray}{\footnotesize\begin{gathered} \mathrm{AMAT}\;[\mathrm{cycles/access}];\quad T_{\mathrm{hit}}\;[\mathrm{cycles/lookup}];\quad m\;[\mathrm{miss\ rate,\ no\ unit}]\\ P_{\mathrm{miss}}\;[\mathrm{extra\ cycles/miss}] \end{gathered}} $ **Miss Penalty — 按层级展开**
**Single-level** L1 → DRAM $$ P_{\mathrm{miss}}=T_{\mathrm{DRAM}} $$ $$ \color{gray}{\scriptsize \mathrm{AMAT}=T_{L1}+m_{L1}T_{\mathrm{DRAM}}} $$
**Two-level** L1 → L2 → DRAM $$ P_{\mathrm{miss}}=T_{L2}+m_{L2}T_{\mathrm{DRAM}} $$ $$ \color{gray}{\scriptsize \mathrm{AMAT}=T_{L1}+m_{L1}(T_{L2}+m_{L2}T_{\mathrm{DRAM}})} $$
**Three-level — 拓展推导** L1 → L2 → L3 → DRAM $$ \scriptsize P_{\mathrm{miss}}=T_{L2}+m_{L2}(T_{L3}+m_{L3}T_{\mathrm{DRAM}}) $$ $$ \color{gray}{\scriptsize \mathrm{AMAT}=T_{L1}+m_{L1}(T_{L2}+m_{L2}(T_{L3}+m_{L3}T_{\mathrm{DRAM}}))} $$
$ \color{gray}{\footnotesize\begin{gathered} T_{L1},\,T_{L2},\,T_{L3}\;[\mathrm{cycles/lookup\ at\ that\ level}];\quad T_{\mathrm{DRAM}}\;[\mathrm{extra\ cycles/DRAM\ access}]\\ m_{L1},\,m_{L2},\,m_{L3}\;[\mathrm{miss\ rate,\ no\ unit}];\quad m_{L2},\,m_{L3}=\mathrm{local\ miss\ rate} \end{gathered}} $ $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{Miss Rates as decimals: }4\%=0.04\qquad\text{Avoid double-counting total Miss Cost}}$ #### CPI — Cycles Per Instruction (cycles/instruction) **Memory Stall** → CPU waits for Memory data after a Cache Miss; **Stall ≠ Store** **Core Formula** $$ \boxed{CPI=CPI_{\mathrm{base}}+CPI_{\mathrm{stall}}} $$ $ \color{gray}{\footnotesize CPI,\;CPI_{\mathrm{base}},\;CPI_{\mathrm{stall}}\;[\mathrm{cycles/instruction}];\quad CPI_{\mathrm{base}}=\mathrm{without\ stalls};\quad CPI_{\mathrm{stall}}=\mathrm{memory\ stall\ cost}} $ **Memory Stall Formula** $$ \boxed{CPI_{\mathrm{stall}}=A_{\mathrm{mem}}\times m\times P_{\mathrm{miss}}} $$ $ \color{gray}{\footnotesize A_{\mathrm{mem}}\;[\mathrm{memory\ accesses/instruction}];\quad m\;[\mathrm{miss\ rate,\ no\ unit}];\quad P_{\mathrm{miss}}\;[\mathrm{extra\ cycles/miss}]} $ [Time = Total Cycles × Clock Period — Q1 Performance](https://yajing5027.github.io/Nodal/?view=note&id=node-computer-architecture-study-notes§ion=sec-performance)
